dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to analyze search result pages, ranking patterns, intent, SERP features, and content opportunities; the instructions and reference templates align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: It allows WebFetch and discusses optional Firecrawl/Tavily connector commands for live SERP data; this network access is disclosed and directly tied to SERP analysis, though users should understand third-party SERP providers may receive query text.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instruction and reference files only, with no executable files detected and clean static, SkillSpector, and VirusTotal inputs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requested inputs are keywords, location/language/device context, SERP screenshots, and top-result URLs, which are proportionate for SEO research.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents to save reusable SERP summaries and promote durable findings to memory files; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it may retain keyword strategy and competitor notes locally.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you are comfortable with an SEO skill fetching or using live search-result data and saving SERP analysis notes in local memory. Avoid providing confidential campaign details unless you are comfortable with them being included in saved research summaries or sent to any optional SERP connector you choose to use.
llm.summary: This SERP-analysis skill is a disclosed SEO research workflow that uses web/SERP data and local memory notes in ways that fit its stated purpose.
